In South Carolina, we know our farmers are the backbone of our communities. Thanks to the Working Families Tax Cut, farmers and their families in the Palmetto State will see $49 million in savings on crop insurance - delivering real relief for those who feed and fuel America.

Congratulations to @USCAiken women’s polo team on their national championship victory! What an incredible performance - way to represent the Palmetto State.


USC Aiken (@USCAiken)

Our women’s polo team claimed the national title after a dominant 15–6 victory over Texas A&M at the 2026 USPA Division I National Intercollegiate Championship in Dallas.

Join us in congratulating these ladies on an unforgettable season and championship win! 🏇🏆
